programmes.d: A mother confronts a man who quit his job and left his wife and three children to pursue a relationship with her teen daughter.
A former middle-school teacher tells of being charged with rape after police found her in a motel room with a 15-year-old former student, 650 miles from their hometown.
Former teacher Tanya Ramirez, who had sex with a 17-year-old who attended the school where she taught, sues him and his mother, and they face off on stage.
Teacher-student sexual relations.
The doctor speaks to a high-school teacher who was accused of sexual misconduct by three of her students.
The doctor continues to investigate a teacher sex-scandal that has rocked a small Texas town.
A 35-year-old former high-school teacher, who has had two babies by a student, considers herself the victim.
